TC-001.title: typed deployed card with missing artifact stays running
TC-001.run: `HERMES_HOME=$(mktemp -d) .venv/bin/python <isolated smoke script>`, creating a running `deployed` card and calling `complete_task` without `metadata.verification.artifact`.
TC-001.expect: completion raises `CompletionVerificationError`, report contains `missing_artifact`, and the card status remains `running`.
TC-001.wiring: Kanban completion entry point -> `kanban_db.complete_task` -> `verify_completion` -> persisted task status and blocking event.

TC-002.title: typed deployed card with required artifact completes
TC-002.run: `HERMES_HOME=$(mktemp -d) .venv/bin/python <isolated smoke script>`, creating a running `deployed` card and calling `complete_task` with a valid deployed artifact including URL and successful smoke-test command.
TC-002.expect: completion returns successfully and the card status is `done`.
TC-002.wiring: Kanban completion entry point -> `kanban_db.complete_task` -> artifact contract validation -> durable done transition and verification report.
